scripts.generate:secrets: dotenv -e .env -- bash -c 'echo "namespace Secrets" > source/config/secrets.bs && echo "    function getFlickrApiKey() as string" >> source/config/secrets.bs && echo "        return \"$FLICKR_API_KEY\"" >> source/config/secrets.bs && echo "    end function" >> source/config/secrets.bs && echo "end namespace" >> source/config/secrets.bs'
scripts.test: npm run generate:secrets && dotenv -e .env -- bash -c 'bsc --project bsconfig.test.json --host $ROKU_HOST --password $ROKU_PASSWORD'
